about_the_game:
• 20 Monsters total (14 immediately available, 6 to unlock).

  • 2 Monster options for Starters (finish a run to unlock a random available Monster as a Starter, all 20 monsters can be Starters).

  • 21 Move Tomes to teach to your Monsters

  • 6 Different Enemies to face, each with unique patterns to learn and counter

  • 3 Nights' worth of gameplay in each run (7 in the full version)

The ultimate monster taming game for players who’d rather battle and try interesting team line-ups than grind levels!

Every run is an opportunity to try new monsters and combos, and takes approximately 45min-1h to complete. Completing a run also unlocks a random monster as a starter option.

Each run begins by choosing a monster (every monster can be unlocked as a potential starter). From there you’ll encounter tombstones with monsters to reanimate and add to your roster, so you can craft the ideal 2-monster team to battle with.

Choosing a starter helps alleviate the randomness between runs, ensuring you always have a monster you enjoying playing with. And there’s always the random option for those who enjoy the chaos!

You start each turn with 3 Action Points (AP). Every Move has a cost, and you can use Moves from either monster on your team – or both!

Chain together multiple Moves to unleash powerful combos and devastate your opponents.

Each night’s main objective is to return to the Necromancer’s Citadel in the middle of the map. Along the way you’ll encounter more monsters to reanimate, powerful move tomes and passives, and unique enemies to face.

Some monsters won’t appear in a run until you unlock them by completing certain challenges, such as:

  • Using the same move 5 times in a turn

  • Dealing 100 Damage with a single Move

  • Using at least 5 different Monster Team combinations in a single run

  • Win a battle without using any Offensive Moves

And many more!

name: Necromancer For A Week Demo
short_description: Monster Taming meets Roguelike gameplay! Over the course of 3 nights you'll reanimate monsters, teach them powerful moves and passives, and compete in 2v2 Battles to become the ultimate Necromancer!
